name: OpenAI
description: GPT models, ChatGPT, the OpenAI API, Codex, Sora, partnerships, leadership and policy.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.166.0 adds transcript search and model catalog support
items.summary: Codex CLI 0.166.0 adds keyboard-driven transcript selection with integrated search and configurable shortcuts, adds GPT-6.1 Terra to bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock catalogs, and introduces clearer safety-block explanations plus network-only diagnostics. These changes improve transcript navigation and broaden model/provider and troubleshooting support for Codex users.

items.title: OpenAI updates its Model Spec around five core values
items.summary: OpenAI reorganized its public model-behavior guidance around five values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. The update also adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency and adjusts some behavioral defaults, making it a substantive change to OpenAI’s stated approach to model behavior.

items.title: OpenAI details expanded monitoring for frontier-model misalignment
items.summary: OpenAI published details of its expanded system for monitoring frontier models for misalignment and potentially unauthorized agent behavior. The company says it evaluates monitoring performance against recorded incidents and simulated attacks, and tracks recall before deploying changes; the disclosure matters because it explains how OpenAI aims to identify and investigate concerning model behavior.

items.title: Ropes & Gray develops transactional-diligence AI with OpenAI
items.summary: Ropes & Gray is developing a proprietary OpenAI-powered tool for the first pass of commercial contract diligence. It reviews and groups documents, generates summaries and a report in the firm’s format, and is intended to help lawyers move from document review to client advice more quickly while preserving lawyer judgment.

items.title: ChatGPT begins beta texting for dot agents via iMessage and RCS
items.summary: OpenAI began rolling out texting for its dot agent through iMessage and RCS, allowing users to send text, photos, and voice messages and receive proactive updates. The beta preview is for ChatGPT Pro users in the U.S., extending access to the agent beyond the ChatGPT app.

items.title: OpenAI offers eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers up to $500 monthly in API credits
items.summary: Eligible ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers can claim monthly OpenAI API credits to build apps and agents, with the benefit reaching up to $500 per month. Pro allowances vary by tier, while Business credits are pooled by workspace and capped at $500 per monthly billing period.

items.title: OpenAI spotlights Legora’s legal-work AI platform and use of OpenAI products
items.summary: OpenAI profiled Legora’s legal AI platform, which uses OpenAI models for workflows including agentic legal work and document review. The article also notes Legora’s use of ChatGPT Work, Codex, and dots, illustrating the company’s products across both customer-facing software and internal operations.

items.title: OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are expanding their partnership to bring Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and to develop new Oracle products and services powered by OpenAI. U.S. Oracle customers will also be able to purchase the OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work through Oracle Marketplace, broadening the partnership’s enterprise and developer reach.

items.title: OpenAI and Fanatics launch AI-powered Shop the Look
items.summary: Fanatics launched Shop the Look, an OpenAI-powered feature that recommends coordinated, in-stock merchandise to sports fans. OpenAI says its team and Fanatics used Codex to develop recommendation tools, and testing across roughly 30,000 MLB products produced 10% higher engagement than the previous experience.

items.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner on AI safety and security
items.summary: OpenAI announced a partnership with Poland’s NASK focused on AI safety, security, and technical research. The collaboration is intended to strengthen safeguards and support a more resilient digital ecosystem; it was published before the monitoring start date.
